## Summary
Implements **P08.2 — the §29 reconciliation workflows**, layered on the P08.1 `RESOLVE()` resolver. Each per-predicate workflow ships as a thin, immutable value-object module in `reconcile/` that **emits** contradictions, research tasks, and (for attribution) an L4 `probable` inference. Per **ADR-036**, nothing here persists: P08.3 (§31) owns the materialized `Contradiction` entity and P12.x (§30) owns the L4 inference layer. Spec: `docs/2_canonical_design_spec.md` §29; ticket `docs/tickets/P08.2__reconciliation-workflows.md`.

§29.1 camera-count reconciliation (SIG-RECON-026..029) already landed in the P06.1 slice (`reconcile/counts.py`) and is re-verified green here.

## What changed
- `reconcile/src/reconcile/attribution.py` (§29.2), `sharing.py` (§29.3), `lifecycle.py` (§29.4), `retention.py` (§29.5), `policy_config.py` (§29.6), `snapshot_diff.py` (§29.7), `additional.py` (§29.8).
- `reconcile/src/reconcile/model.py` — a shared L4 `Inference` value object (aligned with `inference.derived_fact`) whose L4/`is_observation`/`pushable_to_osm` invariants are type-enforced, plus the full contradiction-type vocabulary (`CONTRADICTION_TYPES`).
- `reconcile/pyproject.toml` + `uv.lock` — `reconcile` gains a `sig-db` workspace dependency to **reuse** `db.edtf.derive_envelope` (ADR-024) for lifecycle ordering rather than duplicate the envelope ruleset (the derivation is pure; no Postgres runtime coupling).
- Tests: 7 new files under `tests/reconcile/` (67 new tests).
- Phase-gate docs: `docs/adr/ADR-036-*.md`, `docs/traceability.md` (P08.2 section), `docs/risk_register.md` (Phase 8 section + ADR deviation).

## Design decisions
- **Value objects, no persistence** — follows the `counts.py`/ADR-031 precedent and avoids pre-empting P08.3/P12.x ownership.
- **Reuse EDTF envelopes from `db`** — single source of truth for the ADR-024 ruleset over a duplicated implementation.
- **Attribution scores the six SIG-RECON-030 signals on given candidates**; spatial *generation* from geometry is a downstream (db/inference) concern (noted in ADR-036 / RISK-P8-09).
